title: Formal standings
description: Maintain complete formal standing revisions scoped by season, stage, group and round.
snapshotWarning: Every publication is a complete snapshot, not a row append. Standing revisions are completely independent from match revisions.
overwriteWarning: This table already has a formal revision. Publishing creates a new immutable revision and moves the current pointer; prior revisions remain preserved.
clearWarning: This publishes an empty standing snapshot. An empty supplier response or missing collection is not evidence for clearing; confirm this is an explicit manual decision.

messages.optionsFailed: Failed to load season, stage, group, round or team options.
messages.scopeRequired: Select a season. A round snapshot also requires a round.
messages.scopeFailed: Failed to create the scope. Check season, stage, group and round relationships.
messages.reasonRequired: Enter a publication reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.rowRequired: Every row requires a team and a positive position.
messages.duplicateTeam: A team may appear only once in a revision.
messages.arithmetic: Played must equal wins plus draws plus losses, and goal difference must equal goals for minus goals against.
messages.formInvalid: Form may contain only W, D and L separated by commas.
messages.adjustmentForbidden: Disciplinary point adjustments require the dedicated permission.
messages.adjustmentPair: Points before adjustment and points adjustment must both be set or both be empty.
messages.adjustmentArithmetic: Points before adjustment plus the adjustment must equal the official final points.
messages.clearForbidden: Clearing an existing formal standing requires the dedicated permission.
messages.published: A new formal standing revision was published.
messages.publishFailed: Publication failed. Reload and check the revision, scope, permissions and arithmetic.
